title: The Grateful Dead Live at Field House, U. of Cincinnati on 1970-04-03
source: SBD MR>R>FLAC; Monitor Noise throughout show; tranfer Matt Smith 7/2011

ai_review.summary: A top‑tier ’70 show captured in an outstanding recording, highlighted by a memorable acoustic Wake Up Little Susie, though one reviewer gave a low rating.
ai_review.review: Reviewers rave about this concert as one of the best shows and recordings from 1970, praising the crisp sound and the special moment when Jerry and Bob slipped into matching jeans, white tees and Martin acoustics for an unforgettable acoustic Wake Up Little Susie. While one fan gave a zero‑star rating—likely reflecting personal context rather than audio flaws—the overall impression is that both performance and tape quality are excellent.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong positive comments on both the show and recording outweigh a single low rating; limited data yields moderate confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as one of the best recordings from that year with no noted flaws.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No detailed setlist comments, but reviewers highlight an especially magical acoustic moment early in the show.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for his acoustic performance with a Martin guitar, matching jeans and white tee.
band_member_comments.Bob: Highlighted for joining Jerry on the acoustic version of Wake Up Little Susie.
